verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs claim "reactive and fast state updates with fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals," which directly matches declaring reactive state and re-running only the dependent UI code. The community complaints about $digest dirty-checking concern legacy AngularJS (1.x), not Signals, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: detailed docs on signal/computed/effect APIs and template dependency tracking, independent or hands-on confirmation that only dependent code re-runs.
